title: nVent Introduces Color Smart Ground Rod System to Reduce Product Selection Time and Installation Errors
summary: LONDON—September 30, 2026—nVent Electric plc (NYSE: NVT), a global leader in electrical connection and protection solutions, today announced the launch of the nVent ERICO Color Smart Ground Rod System, a color-coded copper-bonded grounding system designed to simplify product selection, reduce installation errors and improve productivity for contractors and distributors.
body_markdown:
LONDON—September 30, 2026—nVent Electric plc (NYSE: NVT), a global leader in electrical connection and protection solutions, today announced the launch of the[nVent ERICO Color Smart Ground Rod System](http://go.nvent.com/nVentERICOColorSmart.html) , a color-coded copper-bonded grounding system designed to simplify product selection, reduce installation errors and improve productivity for contractors and distributors.


By making it easier to identify and match compatible grounding components, the coordinated color-coding system helps teams work more efficiently regardless of skill level or language. The Color Smart Ground Rod system includes nVent ERICO Copper-Bonded Ground Rods, plus compatible accessories, including the nVent ERICO Hammerlock and Lay-In Hammerlock Ground Clamps.


“The Color Smart Ground Rod System uses functional color cues to help customers see the right solution faster, choose compatible products with confidence and install with less guesswork,” said nVent Vice President and General Manager Matt Flemming. “As contractors face increasing pressure from labor shortages, compressed project schedules and growing installation complexity, this system makes product selection and accessory matching more intuitive.”


The Color Smart Ground Rod System includes:


**Copper-Bonded Ground Rod Size** **Compatible Copper-Bonded Connector** **Copper-Bonded Ground Rod and Accessory Color**


3/4 inch nVent ERICO Hammerlock Ground Clamp, Universal Grounding Acorn Clamp and Couplers


Yellow


5/8 inch nVent ERICO Hammerlock Ground Clamp, Universal Grounding Acorn Clamp and Couplers


Silver


1/2 inch nVent ERICO Hammerlock Ground Clamp, Universal Grounding Acorn Clamp and Couplers


Green


3/8 inch Universal Grounding Acorn Clamp


White


The Color Smart Ground Rod System will be on display at the 2026 National Electrical Contractors Association (NECA) Convention and Trade Show at nVent booth 2112. Convention attendees will see the complete color-coded grounding system in person, learn how components are matched using visual identification and explore how the system can help reduce jobsite confusion and installation errors.


nVent is a leading manufacturer of ground rods and offers a complete line of ground rods and accessories to accommodate various project types. From industry leading copper-bonded ground rods to solid copper rods, stainless steel rods, and galvanized rods, nVent has the ground rod solution contractors can depend on. Learn more at[nVent.com/ERICO](https://www.nvent.com/en-us/erico) .


**ABOUT NVENT**


nVent is a leading global provider of electrical connection and protection solutions. We believe our inventive electrical solutions enable safer systems and ensure a more secure world. We design, manufacture, market, install and service high-performance products and solutions that connect and protect some of the world's most sensitive equipment, buildings and critical processes. We offer a comprehensive range of systems protection and electrical connections solutions across industry-leading brands that are recognized globally for quality, reliability and innovation. Our principal office is in London and our management office in the United States is in Minneapolis. Our robust portfolio of leading electrical product brands dates back more than 100 years and includes nVent CADDY, ERICO, HOFFMAN, ILSCO, SCHROFF and TRACHTE. Learn more at[www.nVent.com](https://www.nvent.com/en-us/home) .
